title: Client-Side HMAC Secret JWT Signing
description: The Flutter client signs JSON Web Tokens (JWT) locally inside a controller using a hardcoded HMAC symmetric secret key ('SecretKey'). Because the secret resides in the compiled Dart snapshot, any attacker can extract it and forge arbitrary session claims.
attack_vector: An adversary decompiles the APK using jadx or blutter to inspect libapp.so string pools, extracts the SecretKey literal, and mints forged admin/parent JWTs with elevated privileges.
fix_rationale: Never embed JWT signing keys in mobile client binaries. Delegate token issuance and cryptographic signing exclusively to an authenticated backend endpoint over TLS.
